target_bug_relation: The protected property test reads the live rotate angle of the delay button through UIContext.getComponentUtils().getRectangleById('animate_btn_delay').rotate.angle after clicking it. On the pre-fix revision (with the empty attribute animation .animation({}) on the button) the angle stays 0 through the whole observation window; on the post-fix revision (attribute animation removed) the angle reaches 90 within the configured 3 s delay window. The trigger observes only the production component state; it does not assert wall-clock durations.
